'''Chevuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and a [[Chosen (Ki Sazen)|Chosen]] of the [[Cult of Ki Sazen]], which worshiped the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ki Sazen]]. In [[3642 BBY]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Sazen sent Chevuk to the [[Dorant's laboratory|laboratory]] of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ryler Dorant|Dorant]] to obtain [[rakghoul]] biological research, where he was defeated by [[Cipher Nine]].
